evidence: Source reasoning supports the floor, but the configured reward claim remains unmeasured. Workbook check39 (Quality Checks row40) includes blank/static/mock/seed-copy/keyword-stuffed/refusing submissions and expressly exempts off-origin/CDN assets. Frozen task tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires wrong-password refusal followed by a successful correct sign-in; a static picture or health-only response is insufficient. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25 requires a unique UI-created requisition AND new PENDING offer, preserved association and inputs, and retrieval in a separate empty signed-in context; it explicitly rejects static seed responses, no-op successes, browser-only saves and requisition-only apps. Thus a blank page fails render; a static/seed-copy/keyword page, a same-context localStorage mock and an app refusing every action cannot supply the fresh independent-context creation witness. All three scored prompts repeat a unique requisition persistence gate, zeroing every binary outcome or using raw Likert1/normalized0 (functional/prompt.md:9-11; polish/prompt.md:7-8; visual/prompt.md:7-8). Their opening untrusted-content instructions prevent awarding credit merely for rubric keywords. Positive successful controls in functional and polish prevent refusal-only credit. Scoring arithmetic: tests/scoring.toml assigns 0.6/0.2/0.2, gates at0 and functional floor0.05; tests/tools/score.py:40-48 requires both gate scores>0 AND functional>0.05. Independently executed evidence/39/floor-policy.py with the unchanged frozen scorer: synthetic render failure, constraints failure, F=0, and F=0.05 each yield reward0 even with maximal craft inputs; F=.06/P=V=0 yields.036 as a positive control. These invented dimension inputs test policy only and are NOT configured app scores. Hash-verified local/gate-witness.cjs (08ee689584d24a97a8446fb32ca0c4f9d3df100bd6eec14560c4fa63ad8ae31c) deliberately replaces requisition creation with HTTP200 {created:true}; local/gate-witness/results.json (fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75) reports reqSaved/offerSaved/freshReq/freshOffer=false. Golden supplies all those witnesses. The dead_approval variant retains working intake, passes the minimal observations and leaves the attempted offer PENDING; it is a partial product, not evidence that the constraints gate tested settlement or that its final reward was low. No configured reward is reported for any variant. Driver/log hashes match the raw index; verification-local.json binds the command to the frozen solution mount, reports exit0 and8 seconds, and all37 listed frozen source hashes independently matched. This8-second scripted duration is not judge timing. Conforming alternative: instruction.md permits no imported operational history and external browser CDN assets. Render wording allows empty operational collections; constraints creates its own unique data and accepts generated IDs, equivalent money/date representations, optional field defaults and any observed routes. Such an alternative is not excluded by the source floor tests; no configured alternative score was measured. Residual risk: raw-evidence-index.json explicitly states no full configured judge/reward ordering evidence, and runtime-evidence.json is absent. There is no configured blank/static/seed-copy/keyword/refusal score pack to establish that the actual judge follows these controls. No concrete surviving floor exploit was demonstrated. Do not call the scripted fixture, source arithmetic, Oracle score or model/portal result interchangeable.
counterexample: Attempted broken app: HTTP200 no-op requisition creation. The local scripted witness rejects it because fresh records never appear. An all-refusing/static variant likewise cannot meet the new-record gate by source reasoning. A surviving configured-score counterexample has not been measured.
suggested_fix: Keep shared scoring policy unchanged; when separately authorized, run the frozen configured verifier on representative blank/static/seed-copy/keyword/refusal mocks and an initially empty conforming app, retain hash-bound gate and final-score evidence, and investigate any nonzero floor result before clearance.
